purpose: Paired, non-clinical comparison of the current VIAGO assessment and research Design B/capped.

populations.name: experienced_viago_users
populations.purpose: Assess recognizable dominant/secondary color continuity against prior VIAGO experience without treating prior labels as ground truth.

populations.name: new_test_takers
populations.purpose: Assess clarity, completion, gameability, and within-person legacy/new agreement without prior-model anchoring.

design.order: Randomly assign half to legacy-first and half to Design-B-first; stratify by experienced/new population.
design.initial_interval: 48-72 hours between legacy and Design B to limit recall while keeping circumstances reasonably stable.
design.retest_subset: At least 60 participants, balanced across populations, repeat Design B after 14-21 days with a new stored seed.
design.assembly: Design B/capped, bank and assembler versions frozen, seed and complete manifest stored.
design.answer_handling: Each assessment is answered normally. Never project answers onto questions the participant did not receive.
design.blinding: Do not identify which version is legacy or research until both initial assessments and feedback are complete.
